mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 4.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand cycle, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising unemployment rate signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE is below 3.5% and rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% (m/m).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past three months indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past six months reflects a tightening labor market, which typically precedes corporate wage pressures and higher inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has declined for six consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,400,000 units annually, it signals robust residential construction activity, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1400.0 (thousands of units).
